title: Paperstone: Add the first competitor-price comparison design, moving Add to Basket down.

change.control: Original product pages without competitor comparison.
change.variant: Add the first competitor-price comparison design, moving Add to Basket down.

quote: On both counts, the variation recorded a poorer performance than the control. However, the results were statistically inconclusive.
notes: Direction means statistically inconclusive, not zero observed change. Publisher reports over 12,000 visitors and poorer add-to-basket and sales estimates, without a numeric effect. The second design later won.
